title: Space Resource → Qualified Feed → Universal Printer Function Matrix
principle: local bulk material plus small carried specialty concentrates can yield high imported-mass leverage; every local source passes characterization/beneficiation/extraction/assay/passport before printing

routes: carbothermal or other validated extraction routes
UTP_functions: silicon / solar-cell feed after high-purity processing
resource_classes.evidence_boundary: exact purity and alloy/device suitability are downstream process qualifications, not implied by extraction alone

resource_classes.source: carbonaceous asteroid class / Bennu-like primitive material as evidence analogue
resource_classes.bulk_character: clay/silicate-rich material with carbon-bearing/volatile-bearing phases; Bennu samples also show carbon, nitrogen, water-related/hydrated minerals, carbonates, iron oxides/sulfides and phosphates
resource_classes.warning: heterogeneous primitive material is chemically valuable but is not direct printer feed; beneficiation and contamination control dominate
exact site mineralogy and atmospheric-processing route remain location/process specific

resource_classes.source: failed/retired parts, slag, support material, cuttings, captured dust
UTP_functions: highest-priority secondary feed where material identity is recoverable
resource_classes.rule: re-characterize before reuse; do not assume original material state survives service/reprocessing

seed_concentrate_strategy.aim: maximize L_seed without breaching functional or evidence requirements
examples: abundant local metal/silicate carrier + low-mass dopant/alloying concentrate
local glass/dielectric + carried phosphor or active optical concentrate
local structural/conductor mass + carried semiconductor die/dopant until local semiconductor purity is qualified
local electrode structure + carried electrolyte/specialty salts until local chemistry route matures
seed_concentrate_strategy.link_to_DILUTE: DILUTE/DOPE operators let scarce high-function material be spatially concentrated only where function requires it rather than homogenized through the entire part
